name: 07756 · Ocean Grove, NJ
findings: ZIP 07756 (Ocean Grove) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (67%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07756 (Ocean Grove) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 07756 (Ocean Grove) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 17% of all organizations here have no identified type.
